Spells:
Control Weather (Greater Dragonmark Mark Of Storm7 Tran): Modifies seasonal weather in a 2 mile radius for 4d12 hr
Control Winds (Greater Dragonmark Mark Of Storm5 Tran): R400' Changes wind direction and speed by 3 levels in a 400'x40' cylinder for 100 min
Endure Elements (Least Dragonmark Mark Of Storm1 Abju): Touched remains comfortable between -50F and 140F for 1 day
Fog Cloud (Least Dragonmark Mark Of Storm2 Conj): R200' 20' radius fog obscures vision for 100 min
Gust Of Wind (Least Dragonmark Mark Of Storm2 Evoc): Creates a 60' line of wind for 1 rd that moves objects, extinguishes unprotected flames, knocks down Small and smaller creatures, and halts Medium ones; Tiny creatures are also pushed 1d4x10', suffering 1d4 HP nonlethal per 10'; flying Medium, Small, or Tiny creatures are instead pushed 1d6x5', 1d6x10', or 2d6x10', with Tiny flying creatures also suffering 2d6 HP nonlethal (save Fortitude negates)
Sleet Storm (Lesser Dragonmark Mark Of Storm3 Conj): R800' 40' radius, 20' high cylinder blocks sight, extinguishes small fires, and requires a DC 10 Balance check to move at half speed (failure by 5 or more causes a fall) for 10 rd
Wind Wall (Lesser Dragonmark Mark Of Storm3 Evoc): R200' Creates a 100'x50'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 10 rd
Wind's Favor (Lesser Dragonmark Mark Of Storm3 Tran): R200' Creates a 10'x10'x200' 30 MPH wind for 10 hr
Magic Notes:
Greater Dragonmark (Mark Of Storm): Can use a choice of Control Winds or Control Weather once per day as a spell-like ability
Least Dragonmark (Mark Of Storm): Can use a choice of Endure Elements, Fog Cloud, or Gust Of Wind once per day as a spell-like ability
Lesser Dragonmark (Mark Of Storm): Can use a choice of Sleet Storm, Wind's Favor, or Wind Wall once per day as a spell-like ability
